prof.sum: Essex Property Trust, Inc., an S&P 500 company, is a fully integrated real estate investment trust. The firm acquires, develops, redevelops, and manages multifamily residential properties in selected West Coast markets. Essex Property Trust, Inc. was incorporated in 1971 in Maryland and is based in San Mateo, United States.
